instruction: Observe a component classify its condition and route it to accepted or rejected handling with a verified inspection result.

skills.name: inspect-component
skills.instructions: Capture first then classify. This example requires real action bindings before execution.

actions.name: classify_component
actions.description: Classify and report the inspection condition

skills.name: record-inspection
skills.description: Record an accepted or rejected inspection
skills.instructions: Select the recording action from the classification exit. Reject is a valid completed inspection not a technical failure.

limitations: Schema example only no inspection simulator or action bindings are provided
